units.source_text: 稍松开手，女子就瘫软下来。

en.t: As soon as he loosened his grip a little, the woman went limp.

units.source_text: 他搂着她的脖子，她的发髻差点儿被他的脸颊压散了。

en.t: He had his arm around her neck, and her coiffure almost came undone under the pressure of his cheek.

units.source_text: 他顺势将手探入她的怀里。

en.t: Following the motion, he slipped his hand into her bosom.
